blockers.description: Root-owned processorN/ directories left behind by --rm docker runs collide with the next stage's automatic redecomposition from 0/.

blockers.description: 47/~100 IPOPT major iterations completed within the 60-minute time box; objective plateaued in a tight band but first-order optimality/feasibility metrics (1.4e-5, 9.0e-5) had not yet reached the 1e-5 target when time ran out.
blockers.resolution: Reported as an honest partial result per instructions; not claimed as a converged optimum.

lesson: The costly failures tonight were infrastructure, not numerics: check_totals on a 105-DV case (vs 8 on the NACA0012 A1 case) is an hour-plus, all-or-nothing run because prob.check_totals() buffers its comparison table until every one of the 210 FD perturbations finishes -- losing it to an OOM/reboot at 81% complete meant zero partial credit and a full 3.5-core-hour rerun. The --memory=12g cgroup cap did exactly its job (killed the container cleanly, not the host), which validates the sizing discipline this ladder has been using; wide-DV cases should be budgeted assuming a multi-hour, must-not-be-interrupted check_totals window. Numerically, this 105-DV 3D wing case verified its adjoint at least as well as the 8-DV NACA0012 airfoil case (A1) across every derivative category -- reassuring evidence that DAFoam's discrete adjoint accuracy does not degrade with design-variable count or geometric complexity on this problem class.
